about:

Write a few lines about yourself here: how long you've been modeling, the kind of projects you like, and what studios can expect when working with you.

aboutCards.title: Blender & ZBrush
aboutCards.text: I model in Blender, sculpt in ZBrush and texture in Substance Painter.

aboutCards.title: Stylized
aboutCards.text: Bright, readable shapes that fit the Roblox look and stay clear on small screens.

aboutCards.title: Flexible deals
aboutCards.text: Single commissions, fixed-price contracts or long-term work with a studio.

aboutCards.title: Fast and optimized
aboutCards.text: Clean topology and tight tri budgets, so the models run well on mobile.
